mapper.select: SELECT r.spu_id,t.id tag_id,t.tag_code,t.name,t.status FROM product_tag_relation r JOIN product_tag t ON t.id=r.tag_id AND t.deleted=FALSE WHERE r.deleted=FALSE AND r.spu_id IN #{spuId} ORDER BY r.spu_id,t.sort_order,t.id
SELECT tag_id FROM product_tag_relation WHERE deleted=FALSE AND spu_id=#{spuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_tag_relation(spu_id,tag_id,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by) SELECT s.spu_id,t.tag_id,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,#{operator},#{operator} FROM (VALUES (#{spuId}::BIGINT)) AS s(spu_id) CROSS JOIN (VALUES (#{tagId}::BIGINT)) AS t(tag_id) ON CONFLICT (spu_id,tag_id) WHERE deleted=FALSE DO NOTHING
